name: Intake and exhaust camshafts
what: The B16 DOHC cylinder head uses two complete camshafts. Each shaft assembly is built from the supplied Camshaft 1, Camshaft 2, and Camshaft Lobes meshes.
why: The camshaft profiles control valve lift, duration, and timing, allowing the cylinders to breathe and supporting the engine's VTEC operation.
where: Both complete camshaft assemblies sit in the two parallel upper camshaft galleries of the cylinder head, above the valve springs and retainers.
installationReason: Each camshaft is assembled from all three supplied source meshes. The complete assembly is duplicated for the second camshaft gallery, using the 4-unit separation visible in the supplied assembled OBJ.

guide.overview: The B16 uses dual overhead camshafts: one operates the intake valves and the other operates the exhaust valves.
guide.operation: As the crankshaft turns, the timing belt drives the camshafts. Each lobe pushes the valve mechanism to open a valve; the valve spring returns it toward its seat as the lobe rotates away. VTEC changes the effective valve-lift and timing behavior by engaging a different rocker profile under the required operating conditions.
guide.construction: Each of the two camshafts is represented by the combined Camshaft 1, Camshaft 2, and Camshaft Lobes source meshes. The complete three-piece assembly is duplicated for the second camshaft gallery.
guide.specifications: Exact B16 engine-code-specific cam lift, duration, journal dimensions, timing marks, and service limits are not asserted here. These values should be taken from the matching Honda service information.
guide.inspection: Inspect cam lobes and journals for scoring, pitting, discoloration, and abnormal wear. Check oil passages and measure journal diameters and lobe heights against the correct B16 service specifications.
guide.failureModes: Possible issues include worn or scored lobes, damaged journals, oil-starvation damage, incorrect cam timing, and blocked oil feeds. Symptoms and limits depend on the exact B16 variant.
